This is likely to mislead users during debugging. Consider rewording to reference the actual manifest being read (e.g., “Markdown lint package.json” / “the Markdown lint package manifest”) or include the manifest path in the message.

reply.body:
`canonicalManifest` resolves the same `path.join(root, 'package.json')` file; the CLI uses the repository root, and explicit-root callers use repository fixtures. The diagnostic names the correct file and field, so no product change is selected.
[Full decision, options, scores and evidence](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/aedfe1dae29084699e020707a3cec16508bea28e/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A07/TF67-R2-root-manifest.md).
